welcome.title: Welcome to Confide
welcome.tagline: Real-time meeting copilot. Powered by GPT-Realtime-Whisper + Claude 4.6.

screenRecording.title: Screen Recording permission
screenRecording.body: Confide needs Screen Recording access to capture meeting audio (Zoom, Meet, Teams). We never see your screen — only system audio.
screenRecording.afterEnable: After enabling, quit and restart Confide for the permission to take effect.

macosTooOld.title: macOS 13 or later required
macosTooOld.body: Confide uses Apple's ScreenCaptureKit framework to capture meeting audio without requiring third-party drivers like BlackHole. This framework is only available on macOS 13.0 (Ventura) and later. macOS 12 support is on our roadmap.
